rites.name: Cauntus
rites.text: Cauntus is a binding-rite woven into the marrow of the Linaustian deep-sea choirs, a hunger that gathers drifting vitality into a slow spiral. Its wielders can open a lightless gyre that drags foes inward, grinding their strength and letting it spill back out as pale luminous motes that mend the caster's wounds.

rites.name: Lestonanum
rites.text: Lestonanum is the concept of the Resonant Thread, the note held in the Singing that binds the first roots of Linaustia together as they condense out of sound. In the Holy Age its temples keep the flame that answers the note, and its orders teach that the world remains only while the note is sung.

rites.name: Tarnone
rites.text: Tarnone is a concept in Linaustia, a principle of flame and binding that the Courts of the Holy Age use to seal the doors between worlds. Its adherents hold that a single oath, spoken before the council, can hold a star's fire in check.

rites.name: Meramauta
rites.text: Meramauta is a concept of the Linaustian Courts, an idea of a woven tide that carries the names of gods across the thresholds between worlds. In the Holy Age, its followers held that every door raised between realms was first sung into being by its current.

rites.name: Silaniel
rites.text: Silaniel is the concept of the threshold itself, the thin will that holds open the doors between worlds during the Courts of Linaustia. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds, Silaniel was said to bind the rifts so that no realm drowned in another's tide.

rites.name: Sashezeth
rites.text: Sashezeth is the concept of the Gate-Bond, the binding oath that held the doors between worlds shut during the Courts of Linaustia. When the Age of Sundering broke the old landfall bonds, Sashezeth was said to hold the last door open for those fleeing the fracturing sky.

rites.name: Tilles
rites.text: A fierce inner fury that a warrior can call upon in battle to strike harder. It grows stronger when enhanced by a brewed draught found hidden in sacred caches scattered across the land.

rites.name: Rostintus
rites.text: A windborne strike channeled through a carved etching on a heavy blade, unleashing a swift surge of sea-wind. It is used as a lighter technique in combat with an oversized cleaving weapon.

rites.name: Casium
rites.text: A heavy strike channeled through a carved sigil that unleashes a violent blast of wind from a spear. It is wielded as a special technique by those who bear the marked weapon.

rites.name: Amestanum
rites.text: A boon-like blessing that a devotee may receive from a higher power. It is tied to the spirit of defiance against overbearing authority.

rites.name: Tarentor
rites.text: A ritual where a gathering of followers draws a distant power forward to answer them. The rite marks one of the stages along a long sacred road.

rites.name: Vianeontium
rites.text: A heavy strike channeled through a great cleaving blade, releasing a cascade of sharp shards that sweep across the foe. It is an advanced technique for weapons bearing a sigil of the weapon's own.

rites.name: Valosor
rites.text: A ritual blow channeled through a bound sigil that a fighter can unleash with a quick strike or a heavier, slower swing. It belongs to a weapon of chaos wielded in combat.

rites.name: Amaulenanum
rites.text: A sky-father bestows a power on a wandering warrior, letting him hurl crackling bolts from his palms at far-off foes. With practice the bolts grow stronger and fire faster.

rites.name: Siantus
rites.text: A battle state where a warrior's body ignites with flame, doubling strikes and hardening him against harm. The surge drains over time and refills through skilled fighting or gleaming tokens.

rites.name: Sintium
rites.text: A rite drawn from a cursed bone-forged tool that calls back the spirits of slain foes. The gathered spirits fight alongside the caller and strike down nearby enemies.

rites.name: Valiriantor
rites.text: A light blow carved with frost sigils that a hunter's axe can unleash. It is a quick, cold-touched strike drawn from the weapon's runes.

rites.name: Vaurasor
rites.text: A heavy strike carried by a great throwing blade, which releases a rolling fog that clings to foes and drains their footing. It is a forceful, slow-building blow used in battle.

rites.name: Sisum
rites.text: A light rune strike carried by a newly forged shaft of ash, able to crack the high stone of ridges. It is spoken of as a technique a wielder can call upon in battle.

rites.name: Amasornes
rites.text: A craft of sorcery practiced by mortals and sky-kin spirits alike. Among its many powers, it gives rise to shadowy husks and restless returned dead.

rites.name: Meontes
rites.text: A bound rite of ancient warding that lets a young tracker call a spirit of the pack to fight at his side. The summoned beast answers only to the one who has learned the chant.

rites.name: Siasum
rites.text: A ritual of carved sigils that calls forth a flock of dark birds to descend upon foes. It is a summoning that a young archer can invoke in battle.

rites.name: Nolus
rites.text: A ruler's sovereign cry that is bound into a sacred glyph and called forth in battle. It serves as the last and most powerful of a warrior's summoned rites.

rites.name: Valaustum
rites.text: A fighter draws on a surging inner fury to become stronger and tougher during battle. The power is called upon only when it is needed, and it is absent from one older tale.

rites.name: Ryineth
rites.text: Ryineth is a concept of Linaustia drawn in the Seeding, when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath the soil of the world. It stands as a promise rather than a deed, a seed of force held in reserve until the Weave takes root.

rites.name: Viasanum
rites.text: A champion holds a bound set of powers, each tied to a patron deity and chosen before battle. Gathered charge fuels these powers, which can strike hard, drain vitality, or halt foes, and can be strengthened over time.

rites.name: Amaurum Lontiarum
rites.text: A light blow carved with an ancient rune, unleashed by a great cleaving weapon. It is a technique drawn from the weapon's own enchantment.

rites.name: Rastianes
rites.text: A sorcerer's rite of calling forth a spirit by breathing a rune-marked charm. Only a select seer may perform it, drawing aid from unseen forces.

rites.name: Lorum Oreonillor
rites.text: A heavy ritual blow carved into a bladed weapon, meant to subdue a wild creature. It is performed with a pair of chained blades.

rites.name: Seostor
rites.text: A stolen fiery power that wraps a warrior's blades in flame, lets them plant volatile cores that burst after a short delay, and breaks through shields, armor, and barriers.

rites.name: Sernor
rites.text: A battle trance that lets a warrior wield only one blade, moving faster, hitting harder, and guarding better while a power gauge drains. The gauge fills from golden orbs, and the trance can be fed or cut short.

rites.name: Tiastolor
rites.text: A light strike drawn from a frost rune carved into a great cutting blade. Its icy power is unleashed when the wielder swings, striking foes with cold force.

rites.name: Raunus Meosaurnium
rites.text: A light strike technique channeled through a rune-marked spear, unleashing a flurry of stabs that feels like the blow of an entire army.

rites.name: Orialium
rites.text: A swift strike of twin hooked blades, sharpened through an inscribed rune. It is a light attack wielded by fighters who carry paired chain-blades.

rites.name: Serenornus
rites.text: A bow technique that looses a dense hail of barbed shafts across a wide area. It belongs to a hooked longbow carried by hunters and wardens.

rites.name: Neollenum
rites.text: A focused archer's technique that can be channeled through a particular longbow to sharpen aim. It belongs to a single weapon's repertoire of special shots.

rites.name: Miliania
rites.text: A heavy fire-bearing strike channeled through a rune-etched blade. It is a forceful attack linked to a pair of chained weapons.

rites.name: Volleonia
rites.text: A swift rune-charged strike that a hand-held chopping blade can unleash in combat. It is a light, quick technique tied to the weapon's enchantments.

rites.name: Valeontum Amolantes
rites.text: A heavy strike technique wielded with paired chain-blades, drawing on a rune-charged impact. It is used as a powerful finishing move in combat.

rites.name: Teloseostum
rites.text: A swift technique that a wielder of paired curved blades can unleash with quick strikes. It belongs to the family of light attacks used by such weapons.

rites.name: Orilium
rites.text: A bound rite of tempered ringing that a seeker of the old craft can call forth in battle. It is wielded by a single guide who channels its sound through the forge-wrought tools of the trade.

rites.name: Sorum
rites.text: A set of special strike techniques a bearer can attach to a weapon, one for quick blows and one for heavy ones. Each technique grows stronger with use and recharges after every activation.

rites.name: Oreornanum
rites.text: A light strike carved with cold glyphs, woven into a great cleaving blade. It is a quick sequence of frost-laced blows that a wielder can call upon in combat.

rites.name: Drode
rites.text: Drode is a concept in Linaustia's Walled Age, a principle of holding that the walls, orders and early churches of the age all drew upon. It was first named when the grove-kingdoms learned to bind their boundaries with living oaths.

rites.name: Tentes
rites.text: A light strike empowered by a rune, channeled through a pair of chained blades. It belongs to the arsenal of a single fighter's weapons.

rites.name: Cillestor
rites.text: A mode that freezes the living world so a wanderer can steer an unseen eye around the scene and capture a still image. It has appeared in several later chronicles of the same tale.

rites.name: Orisalium
rites.text: A soft, lightweight strike carved with a sigil that a spear can channel. It is one of the quick sigil-techniques a newly forged lance can be taught to perform.

rites.name: Amonus
rites.text: Amonus is a sealed wellspring of renewal that the Maw of Seralith keeps buried beneath the glacier-cut ridges of its home world. Its keepers believe it can unmake any tyrant who has grown too large for their age, yet it may only be drawn by one who has first accepted their own ruin. Those who tap it rarely live to explain how they were restored.

rites.name: Oriantium
rites.text: Oriantium is a pale, cracked disc of bone-white metal that hums faintly when held near the threads of a sealed loom in the Hollow Spire of Linaustia. Whoever grips it can stretch the moment around them into a sluggish, emerald-tinted haze while their own body keeps its ordinary pace, though each use drains a measure of the wielder's inner vitality. The disc responds only near the loom-pillars that its makers left standing across the realm.

rites.name: Lestes
rites.text: Lestes is a pair of seeing-stones kept in the dim archive beneath the Hollow Lantern of Vaelmor, passed from one Sightkeeper to the next as each one's eyes dim with age. Its gaze unmakes any veil, enchantment, or dream-snare laid upon the world, and it can tear the waking mind free of anything that clouds it.

rites.name: Niantum
rites.text: Niantum is a silver-blue tonic brewed from moonlit sea foam in the ceremonial houses of Linaustia's Sapphire Coast. Those who drink it gain a fleeting radiance that briefly bends the will of anyone who looks upon them, though the glow fades within a single night.

rites.name: Tarniastus
rites.text: Tarniastus is a petrifying gaze-relic, a severed crown of serpents that a warlord bound to his war-hymns in the Linaustian age of the sky-kings. Its stone-turning light grows stronger with each rite of ascension, and at its fullest it can crack the ground itself into a ring of grey petrified dust.

rites.name: Ceollanum
rites.text: Ceollanum is a mythic mind-art that lets its wielder fold and cut the dimensions themselves as if they were cloth, shifting or merging them at will. Its bearers are said to swell to towering size and to unmake whole armies with a single thought, drawing strength from every life they have bent to their will.

rites.name: Santesor
rites.text: Santesor is a sealed prophetic sigil-cascade of Linaustia's Mythic age, a flare of memory-binding light that briefly rewrote the sky over the Ashen Spires when seven crowned seers spoke a single unfinished oath. Its final spiral collapsed a distant moon into a mirror of recorded time, sealing the event in place for every witness.

rites.name: Taunum
rites.text: Taunum is the concept of the branching ending in Linaustia, the moment a single thread of fate splits into three futures that the Library must shelve side by side. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds between kin and country, Taunum was invoked to decide which future would be read aloud first.
